title: Advancement 1.20 at 1.21.4
description: Some advancement which summarize new functionalities in : 1.20, 1.20.5, 1.21, 1.21.2 & 1.21.4
body:
# ✅ Features

Add 4 advancements tab for a total of 109 new advancements, 20 vanilla advancement are moved in the new tabs and some are modified.

Each tabs summarize an update :
- **1.20 & 1.20.3** → **Trails & Tales** and **Bats and pots** updates
- **1.20.5** → **Armored Paws** update
- **1.21** → **Tricky Trials** update
- **1.21.2 & 1.21.4** → **Bundles of Bravery** and **The Gardens Awakens** updates

Include an advancement tracker which allows you to know your progress per tab. (In progress)

## Tracker

Allows players to see his progress per tab, use `/trigger` commands.

Execute `/trigger trailsTalesMissingAdvancement` to know how much advancemnt you have completed in Trails & Tales tab.

Execute `/trigger armoredPawsMissingAdvancement` to know how much advancemnt you have completed in Armored Paws tab.

Execute `/trigger trickyTrialsMissingAdvancement` to know how much advancemnt you have completed in Tricky Trials tab.

Execute `/trigger gardenBundleMissingAdvancement` to know how much advancemnt you have completed in Bundles of Bravery and the Gardens Awakens tab.

## List of achievements

<details>
<summary>Trails & Tales (and Bats and pots) tab : 34 advancements
(include 4 hinding advancement) and 8 vanilla advancement</summary>

Only visible advancement are listed :

      - 1 hidden advancement

</details>

## Compatibility option

Normally, this datapack is compatible with all other datapack and mods, but if you have a problems check this :
1. If the name space of other datapack/mods are `advancement`, `advancement-rewards` or `tracker`.
2. If the datapacks/mods modify a vanilla which is modified by this datapack.
3. Else, you can report an issues on [github](https://github.com/RSN-Minecraft-Modpack/1.21-advancement-pack/issues).
